descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S26 No points leak between two patients in the same mode (from the list, by deep link, with an unsaved draft)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. … (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Two Hospital patients (QA Hosp A / QA Hosp B) and two Nursing Home residents (QA Resident A / QA Resident B), no points

When Hospital: on A add 'QA-A only: call son', then Add Point again and type 'QA-A draft: ask about cane' without saving; close the editor. Open B from the list, open its editor, type a note and Save Note. Open A's editor again and, while it is open, go to B by its address; open B's editor and Save Note. …

Then B's charts never show or store any A text, in either mode; A's points are unchanged

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): backendChecks after the run: rounding:get(B).importantPoints == [] and importantPointsDraft == ''; snf:get(B).importantPoints == [] and importantPointsDraft == ''; Hospital A texts == ['QA-A only: call son'] (its draft kept, as a draft or a card - recorded for Q4); …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
